column1: # Noctty Zig migration 1A.4, phase 1. Plan 6.1 and 6.4. Measurement and disposition are source-only.

# Fork base 15414a56fae5a704aa16d165b0a1444e8fd286ef. Upstream stone 74d0c72fd9318ad3ab95bfb56f6c2d995e267e2e. v1.4.0 83fb95624b0439ee660c2679b43b38c8b63769cd. Fetched upstream/main 6d244209978e599277904ff3ced7b8a2ebcc528d.

# Scope is the 59 paths in zig017/logs-r4/new-at-stone.txt plus src/terminal/{PageList.zig,page.zig,Screen.zig,Terminal.zig,search/,render.zig,hash_map.zig,ref_counted_set.zig,bitmap_allocator.zig} and src/renderer/State.zig.
# Retained-166 exactly matches git rev-list --full-history --no-merges stone..v1.4.0 in that scope. Upstream-main adds the same check for v1.4.0..upstream/main.
# The review-r1 row of drift-decisions.tsv adds src/os/open.zig. Its three additional pre-tag commits are included; its later range has no nonmerge commits.
# 76 post-tag merge commits appear in the full-history scope walk. Their scoped remerge diffs have no additional edits; their patch commits are counted once.

# Presence uses tools/presence.py as in logs-r5/presence-54.tsv: every eligible added Zig line across the whole commit, stripped, 12+ characters, excluding comments and punctuation-only lines, matched against the same path at the fork base.

# A 1.00 score with 0 eligible lines signifies the method counted no additions. Removals, C headers, docs and other non-Zig changes are assessed in the dispositions. Text anywhere in a file can match; the disposition is based on the source location and retained behavior.
# missing_zig_lines_by_path lists exact omission counts from the matching method. The disposition explains sections that were adapted, deferred, or need restoration.

# Hold names a path or owner requiring the lead decision before any forward-port. A hold on a deferred row records the overlap if moved earlier. 60b43068c, 65ff54c67 and 5b2d3b7df are deferred under Plan 6.3.

# Base follow-up for 1A.5: cli/ghostty.zig dispatches .ssh directly to ssh.run, and ssh.run reaches runInner with no Windows refusal. Plan 6.5 and decisions 16/23 require the interim refusal and a regression before depending on that gate.

# Base follow-up for 1A.5: termio/stream_handler.zig initializes apc.Handler with every protocol enabled and dispatches glyph requests. Plan 6.5 calls for the app handler to drop glyph APCs; the lib-vt allocation cap remains independently applicable.
# Phase 2a preserves the base-presence scores. Port commits and R1A hold decisions are appended to their rows.
